As with fire protection, the high rate of crime is expected to drop with the completion of the Redevelopment Plan. Physically the Plan provides for easier area surveillance, lighted streets, alleys, and walk-ways.
f. Mass Transportation:
(1) The Virginia Transit Company operates one bus route through the Randolph Community. This route depicted in the sketch map below is called the "Fairmont 43". It enters the Randolph Project Area travelling south on Harrison Avenue, then west on Lakeview Avenue to Randolph Street, south on Randolph Street to Winder Street, west on Winder Street to Allen Avenue, north on Allen Avenue to Idlewood Avenue, east on Idlewood Avenue to Harrison Street, then north on Harrison Street out of the Project Area.
Other bus routes serving the Randolph area are located adjacent to the project area. No other forms of public transportation exist.
